label: rectifyesvalidation.vercel.app

label: scratch-assets.vercel.app
title: Scratch - Imagine, Program, Share
reasons: The page impersonates the Scratch educational platform (title: 'Scratch - Imagine, Program, Share', meta description: 'Make games, stories and interactive art with Scratch.') with a login form that submits to a third-party service instead of the real service.
The form action is set to 'https://api.web3forms.com/submit' and includes a hidden 'access_key' field, exfiltrating any entered username and password to an operator-controlled endpoint.
The password field is labeled 'Password:' and named 'key', but the data is sent to api.web3forms.com, not to scratch.mit.edu.

label: discord-verify.vercel.app

The page uses api.ipify.org to fetch the visitor's IP and then sends it to a hardcoded Discord webhook endpoint: 'https://discord.com/api/webhooks/1335446103562256424/...'
The page presents as a 'Discord Verification' tool but its sole technical action is covert exfiltration of the visitor's IP address.
